name: WindowSwitcher
description: Phones: every open window in a bottom sheet, plus the routed view.
signature: ({ open, onOpenChange, primaryLabel, }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; primaryLabel?: string; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state when the sheet is dismissed (swipe, Esc, scrim) and with false after the person chooses a window. Pair with `open`.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: primaryLabel
props.description: Visible label for the primary action.
